replies.body:
Hey Lythure,

I have archived his two posts but will not issue an infraction.
This is because it looks like this is a one time occurrence and he doesn't seem to continue his rude behaviour. Therefore an infraction is not needed.

If he continues in the future, I'll warn him.
But for now, his posts have been removed from the thread.

Thanks for the report!
